{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"HowTo","name":"How to Tell if a Marketplace Item Is Stolen","description":"Check Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, eBay, Mercari, or Poshmark listings using identifiers, seller evidence, red flags, and safer payment steps.","step":[{"@type":"HowToStep","position":1,"name":"Step 1","text":"Find and photograph the item's identifier. Ask for it in the marketplace message thread so the request and response are preserved."},{"@type":"HowToStep","position":2,"name":"Step 2","text":"Analyze the listing and images: Reverse-image search photos, compare the seller’s other listings, read profile history, and preserve screenshots.
